summary: Comfort Systems USA filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, disclosing that its board approved an amendment increasing its stock repurchase authorization to top off the program at up to 1,000,000 shares, adding 994,606 shares to the previously authorized 11,757,964. Through November 4, 2026, the company had repurchased 11,752,570 shares for an aggregate $1,711,769,315, exclusive of excise tax. Repurchases may occur in the open market or privately negotiated transactions, funded from available cash, at management's discretion; the board may modify, suspend, extend, or terminate the program at any time. No price, premium, or advisor was specified; watch execution pace against cash generation and buyback's support for per-share metrics.
